note: CC coherent charged-pion production, νμ + C → μ⁻ + π⁺ + C and ν̄μ + C → μ⁺ + π⁻ + C, on the MINERvA scintillator (CH) tracker but cross section quoted per carbon-12 nucleus (coherent process, whole-nucleus scattering). Three differential/flux-integrated observables, each measured separately for the neutrino- and antineutrino-mode NuMI low-energy beam: dσ/dEπ (pion kinetic energy), dσ/dθπ (pion angle w.r.t. beam), and σ(Eν) (flux-integrated cross section per Eν bin, i.e. not per-GeV — an "event rate vs energy" style plot, not a true differential in Eν). Target: per C-12 nucleus (coherent — whole-nucleus process; column headers in the ancillary CSVs read "cm^2//C^12").
